extension.description: Translate Markdown with OpenRouter, OpenAI, DeepSeek, Moonshot, GLM, Xiaomi MiMo, and custom endpoints without breaking Markdown.
capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces.descrip: MarkLingo reads Markdown documents and can send their content to a configured translation endpoint, so the workspace should be trusted before translation runs.
capabilities.virtualWorkspaces.descripti: MarkLingo currently writes translated files using local filesystem paths and does not support virtual workspace file systems.

configuration.title: MarkLingo
configuration.openrouter.provider.enumDe: Use OpenAI's official Chat Completions endpoint.
Use Xiaomi MiMo's OpenAI-compatible API endpoint.
Use a custom OpenAI-compatible API endpoint, such as llama.cpp server, Ollama, or LM Studio.
configuration.openrouter.baseUrl.descrip: Active provider base URL kept for compatibility. MarkLingo Settings remembers Custom OpenAI Compatible Base URL separately.
configuration.openrouter.modelId.descrip: Active provider model ID kept for compatibility. Prefer MarkLingo Settings for provider-specific model values.
configuration.providers.openrouter.model: Model ID remembered for the OpenRouter provider.
configuration.providers.openai.modelId.d: Model ID remembered for the OpenAI provider.
configuration.providers.deepseek.modelId: Model ID remembered for the DeepSeek provider.
configuration.providers.moonshot.modelId: Model ID remembered for the Moonshot provider.
configuration.providers.glm.modelId.desc: Model ID remembered for the GLM provider.
configuration.providers.xiaomiMimo.model: Model ID remembered for the Xiaomi MiMo provider.
configuration.providers.openaiCompatible: Base URL remembered for the Custom OpenAI Compatible provider.
Model ID remembered for the Custom OpenAI Compatible provider.
configuration.translation.maxBlocksPerRe: Maximum number of Markdown blocks per Chat JSON request. When the smaller-batch request path is active, MarkLingo uses the lower of this value and the Model Blocks setting.
configuration.translation.maxContextUsag: Max share of the model context window used for each translation request prompt when context length is available.
configuration.translation.requestMode.en: Use the verified provider/model behavior when available; otherwise use the standard request path.
Use the standard structured-output request path.
Use smaller Markdown batches for models that need a simpler translation request.
configuration.translation.requestMode.de: Advanced translation request mode. Normally managed by MarkLingo Settings Save and Verify.
configuration.translation.translationMod: Maximum number of Markdown blocks per request for the smaller-batch request path.
Maximum concurrent requests for the smaller-batch request path.
Maximum output tokens per request for the smaller-batch request path. Use 0 to estimate from the model context window.
configuration.translation.targetLanguage: Target language for translation (shown in onboarding on first use).
Custom target language used when targetLanguage is Custom...
configuration.translation.systemPrompt.d: Advanced override for the base system prompt template (not shown in the MarkLingo settings panel). Leave empty to use the extension default. Use {targetLanguage} as the target language placeholder. Editing this can break Markdown and placeholder protection, so most users should use Custom Instructions instead.
configuration.translation.customPrompt.d: Custom instructions appended after the built-in translation prompt, such as terminology or style rules. The base Markdown and placeholder protection always applies.
